China to launch space mission with first Pakistani astronaut

China is set to launch the Shenzhou-24 spacecraft on Wednesday, carrying a crew that includes Pakistani payload specialist Muhammad Zeeshan Ali. Ali will become the first foreign astronaut to visit China's space station. This mission is described as part of the Belt and Road cooperation.
